To address this challenge, we propose a hierarchical rank-evolving (abbreviated as HRE) representation for multivariate functions, which endows us to faithfully capture the underlying structure of the targeted multivariate function accompanying with automatic rank determination. Concretely, in the hierarchical design of HRE representation, the target multivariate function is decomposed as a small-scale inner tensor with a set of univariate functions along each mode, where a customized tensor network decomposition can be readily deployed to capture the underlying structure of the small-scale inner tensor. In HRE representation, the crucial hyperparameters, ranks, can be adaptively revealed during the decomposition, freeing us from manual rank tuning and making HRE practically applicable to real-world problems. Besides, we build the HRE-PINNs correspondingly. Extensive numerical experiments, including high-dimensional static problems (Helmholtz equation and Poisson equation), nonlinear time-dependent problems (Klein-Gordon equation), and complex fluid-dynamics problems (flow mixing equation and Navier-Stokes equation), demonstrate that HRE-PINNs consistently outperform existing state-of-the-art approaches in terms of accuracy.

</details>


### [372] [When Do Task Vectors Interfere? Mapping the Validity Boundaries of Weight-Space Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09490)
*Chencheng Zhu,Xiaoyang Li,Taotao Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了任务算术中参数空间加法与功能变化之间的关系，提出用功能非加性度量来评估任务向量组合的可预测性。实验发现代码+安全性的组合比代码+数学更非加性，且该排序在多规模、多方法、跨架构条件下稳定存在，但对外部验证中的指令包装和EvalPlus指标敏感，表明权重空间组合仅支持粗粒度、输入和格式条件化的功能陈述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任务算术假设微调位移可以作为可组合的方向，但参数加性是否反映功能变化的不确定性仍然存在。作者希望厘清参数几何与功能几何之间的对应关系，回答何时参数加法会导致可预测的功能变化这一基本问题。

Method: 将参数几何与功能几何分离，在二维任务向量表面上测量两两功能非加性。使用首词预测分布交互比率，以输入分布为条件，采用范数匹配对照、三个训练种子和仅响应微调进行评估。在Qwen2.5-1.5B上进行主实验，并扩展到0.5B全参数微调、Qwen2.5 LoRA（至7B）和Llama-3.1-8B跨架构审计，以及外部验证（原始公共提示、指令包装、EvalPlus pass@1）。

Result: 代码+安全性在代码和指令提示上比代码+数学对照更非加性，但在数学提示上不成立。六任务前瞻性扩张中，所有八个高对低比较的未见任务对符号预测均正确。排序在全参数微调、LoRA、跨架构条件下均保持。但外部验证显示原始公共提示能保持连续对比，而指令样式包装会使其失效，EvalPlus pass@1无法稳健复现。

Conclusion: 权重空间组合能支持粗粒度、输入和格式条件化的功能陈述，但不能作为通用的合并性能预测器。非加性的排序在跨方法、跨规模和跨模型族中具有一定鲁棒性，其有效边界取决于具体提示格式和评估指标的选择。

Abstract: Task arithmetic treats fine-tuning displacements as composable directions in weight space, yet it remains unclear when parameter addition reflects predictable changes in model function. We separate parameter geometry from functional geometry and measure pairwise functional non-additivity over a two-dimensional task-vector surface, using a first-token predictive-distribution interaction ratio conditioned on an input distribution and evaluated with norm-matched controls, three training seeds, and response-only fine-tuning. On Qwen2.5-1.5B, code+safety is more non-additive than the matched code+math control on code and instruction prompts, but not on math prompts. In a prospectively specified six-task expansion, all eight high-versus-low comparisons of unseen task pairs have the predicted sign. The primary ordering further persists under full-parameter fine-tuning at 0.5B, Qwen2.5 LoRA scale tests up to 7B, and a Llama-3.1-8B cross-architecture audit. External validation exposes a sharper boundary: raw public code, instruction, and safety prompts preserve the continuous contrast, whereas an instruction-style wrapper collapses it on the identical public-code prompts, and EvalPlus pass@1 interactions do not robustly reproduce it. Weight-space composition therefore supports coarse, input- and format-conditioned functional statements across adaptation methods, scales, and one additional model family, not a universal merging-performance predictor.

</details>


### [373] [Tracking the Best Strategy in an Extensive-Form Game](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09501)
*Stephen Pasteris,Rahul Savani,Theodore Turocy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了扩展形式博弈中的bandit问题，提出一种针对切换遗憾的高效算法，每个试验的时间复杂度仅为O(HB)，达到Õ((1/ρ+ρK)√HAT)的切换遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在扩展形式博弈中，现有研究主要关注标准遗憾，而切换遗憾（衡量学习者在回顾中与任意切换的混合策略序列的表现差距）在直观博弈场景中同样重要，但目前缺乏高效的算法设计。

Method: 提出一个带参数ρ>0的算法，通过权衡参数ρ来控制比较器序列中切换次数K对遗憾的影响，从而在切换后悔界和计算效率之间取得平衡。

Result: 算法实现了Õ((1/ρ+ρK)√HAT)的切换遗憾上界，其中K为比较器序列的切换次数，H为遍历的最大信息集数，A为总动作数，T为试验次数；每次试验的时间复杂度仅为O(HB)，其中B为最大可用动作数。

Conclusion: 该算法在切换遗憾方面达到了接近最优的界，同时保持了极低的时间复杂度，为扩展形式博弈中的在线学习提供了高效实用的解决方案。

Abstract: We consider the extensive-form bandit problem where on each trial the learner plays an extensive-form game against an oblivious adversary. We focus on the notion of switching regret, which measures the expected performance of the learner against that of any switching sequence of mixed strategies in retrospect. Our algorithm takes a parameter $ρ>0$ and achieves a switching regret of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}((1/ρ+ρK)\sqrt{H A T})$ where $K$ is the number of switches in the comparator sequence, $H$ is the maximum number of the learner's information sets that can be traversed during a play of the game and $A$ is the number of actions that the learner can possibly take. Our algorithm is extremely efficient, taking a per trial time of only $\mathcal{O}(H B)$ where $B$ is the maximum number of actions available to the learner at any of its information sets.

</details>


### [374] [Generalized Convexity and Smoothness via Conjugate Duality: Optimization Theory for Deep Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09523)
*Binchuan Qi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过推广经典凸性和光滑性概念（引入H(ψ)-凸性和H(Ψ)-光滑性），建立了一个统一的DNN训练优化框架，提出了广义梯度下降和广义随机梯度下降算法，并理论证明了其收敛性，同时通过梯度相关因子和模型容量风险等指标定量分析了网络架构和训练配置对收敛的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统优化理论依赖可微性、凸性和光滑性等假设，而这些假设在DNN目标函数中常常不成立，导致经典理论无法充分解释深度神经网络训练的成功。作者希望建立一种统一的优化框架来填补这一理论空白。

Method: 利用Legendre函数和凸共轭推广经典凸性和光滑性，提出H(ψ)-凸性和H(Ψ)-光滑性统一框架；在此基础上通过凸共轭引入广义梯度下降（GD）和广义随机梯度下降（SGD）；将DNN训练重构为复合优化问题，引入梯度相关因子和模型容量风险指标进行定量分析。

Result: 理论证明了广义GD的最优学习率恰好为1，推导了两种优化器基于梯度能量的严格收敛速率；通过梯度相关因子和模型容量风险定量分析了网络架构、批大小和模型容量对训练收敛的影响；大量跨架构、数据集、优化器和损失函数的实验验证了理论界的准确性和与经验训练动态的一致性。

Conclusion: 该工作为DNN训练提供了一个统一的理论框架，能够同时涵盖凸/非凸、光滑/非光滑目标函数，揭示了广义光滑性与凸性之间的自然对偶关系，并通过理论—实验的高度一致性证明了框架的有效性和实用价值。

Abstract: Deep neural network (DNN) training with stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and its variants achieves strong empirical performance, yet classical optimization theory does not fully explain this success. This limitation arises because conventional analyses rely on assumptions such as differentiability, convexity, or smoothness, which are often violated by DNN objectives. In this paper, we establish a unified optimization framework for DNN training by generalizing classical convexity and smoothness through Legendre functions and convex conjugation. Specifically, we introduce $\mathcal{H}(ψ)$-convexity and $\mathcal{H}(Ψ)$-smoothness, which unify convex and non-convex as well as smooth and non-smooth objectives within a single formalism and reveal a natural duality between generalized smoothness and convexity. Building on these generalized properties, we introduce generalized gradient descent (GD) and generalized SGD through convex conjugation. We theoretically prove that generalized GD admits an optimal learning rate of exactly $1$, and derive rigorous gradient-energy-based convergence rates for both proposed optimizers. We further reformulate DNN training as a composite optimization problem, demonstrating that its convergence relies on jointly reducing the gradient energy and controlling the induced norm of the network Jacobian. To characterize the practical influences of network architectures and training configurations, we introduce the gradient correlation factor and model capacity risk, and quantitatively analyze how architectural designs, batch size, and model capacity shape training convergence. Extensive experiments across diverse network architectures, datasets, optimizers, and loss functions validate our theoretical bounds and demonstrate precise alignment between our theoretical predictions and empirical training dynamics.

</details>


### [375] [Dual-Adversarial Safety Alignment: Cultivating Intrinsic Threat Comprehension in LRMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09542)
*Hongli Shen,Shaopeng Fu,Qinbo Zhang,Jian Li,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AdvSafe是一个双对抗框架，通过显式解构对抗机制使大型推理模型（LRMs）内化不安全知识，从而实现超越模式依赖的鲁棒认知防御。仅用1K合成样本即可显著提升越狱鲁棒性，且几乎不损失推理效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LRM安全对齐方法多依赖直接拒绝或安全推理，但往往聚焦于提示模式而非内在攻击机制，导致难以泛化到多样化的越狱攻击，在对抗鲁棒性和推理效用之间难以兼顾。

Method: AdvSafe采用两阶段对抗博弈：(1)对抗合成阶段，自主智能体动态生成欺骗性越狱提示，不断调整策略以突破强教师模型；(2)对抗提取阶段，被攻破的教师模型执行认知性反攻，对每次成功越狱解析其伪装方式，解释攻击成功原因以及识别和缓解此类提示的方法。由此生成紧凑的推理数据集，学生模型在该数据集上训练获得内在威胁理解能力。

Result: 实验表明，仅使用1K合成样本，AdvSafe对齐的LRMs在越狱鲁棒性上显著优于现有基线，几乎没有效用损失。此外，AdvSafe还提升了对分布外提示的鲁棒性，表明学习不安全知识能实现更优的鲁棒性-效用权衡，并能泛化到未见过的攻击模式。

Conclusion: AdvSafe证明，通过学习不安全知识而非依赖模式匹配，LRMs可以实现更鲁棒且更通用的安全对齐，在不牺牲推理能力的前提下有效防御多样化越狱攻击。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve remarkable success on complex tasks but remain vulnerable to harmful prompts that induce unsafe outputs. Recent methods align LRMs using direct refusals or safety rationales, yet often focus on prompt patterns rather than intrinsic attack mechanisms. As a result, these pattern-centric alignments struggle to generalize across diverse jailbreaks, compromising adversarial robustness and reasoning utility. We propose AdvSafe, a dual-adversarial framework that enables LRMs to internalize unsafety knowledge by explicitly deconstructing adversarial mechanisms. This moves beyond pattern-dependent traces, fostering robust cognitive defense without compromising reasoning utility. Our pipeline operates via a two-phase adversarial game. First, in adversarial synthesis, an autonomous agent dynamically crafts deceptive jailbreak prompts, adapting its strategies to breach a strong teacher model. Second, in adversarial extraction, the breached teacher executes a cognitive counter-attack. For every successful jailbreak, the teacher unmasks the camouflage, explaining why the attack succeeds and how such prompts can be identified and mitigated. This dual-adversarial process yields a compact reasoning dataset capturing rich, generalizable unsafety knowledge. Student models trained on this dataset implicitly acquire safety alignment through intrinsic threat comprehension. Experiments show that with only 1K synthesized samples, AdvSafe-aligned LRMs achieve significantly stronger jailbreak robustness than existing baselines, with almost no utility degradation. Furthermore, AdvSafe improves robustness against out-of-distribution prompts, demonstrating that learning unsafety knowledge enables a superior robustness-utility trade-off and generalizes beyond seen attack patterns.

</details>


### [376] [Training-Free Universal Approximation by Prompting Random Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09558)
*Alexander Hsu,Rongjie Lai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从逼近论角度证明，即使使用随机、未训练的权重，单层softmax注意力网络在适当的软提示引导下也能逼近紧流形上的任意Hölder函数，即预训练是可选的。通过将softmax注意力与核方法建立联系，作者构造了显式软提示，使冻结的Transformer等效于经典Nadaraya-Watson核估计器，并获得了依赖内在维度的极小极大最优逼近速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解Transformer的表达能力对于区分提示（prompting）、架构和预训练在Transformer模型中的各自作用至关重要，并有助于判断任务特定行为是必须存储在模型权重中，还是可以通过推理时的提示来诱导产生。

Method: 作者利用softmax注意力与核方法之间的理论联系，将注意力logits与高斯核指数相匹配，构造了显式的软提示（每个目标函数对应一个提示，与查询无关）作为线性系统的解，使冻结的Transformer模拟Nadaraya-Watson核估计器。该构造仅需权重满足一个弱的秩条件，作者证明在高斯初始化下该条件几乎必然成立。

Result: 所提示的网络继承了核回归的理论保证，获得了依赖内在维度的最小极大最优逼近速率的通用逼近定理。作者还量化了提示的代价，揭示了构造的软提示词元的范数、提示长度和隐藏维度之间的权衡，并通过数值实验验证了构造和预测速率。

Conclusion: 该研究在逼近论意义上表明预训练对Transformer的表达能力并非必需，随机初始化的注意力网络通过精心设计的提示即可实现强大的函数逼近能力，这为理解提示机制的理论基础提供了新视角。

Abstract: How expressive is prompting a transformer? Answering this question is important for separating the roles of prompting, architecture, and pretraining in transformer models, and for determining whether task-specific behavior must be stored in model weights or can instead be induced at inference time through the prompt. We show, in an approximation-theoretic sense, that pretraining is optional: a single-layer softmax attention network with random, untrained weights can approximate any Hölder function on a compact manifold when steered by an appropriate soft prompt. Guided by the connection between softmax attention and kernel methods, we construct explicit soft prompts (a prompt per target function, independent of the query) as solutions to linear systems matching attention logits to Gaussian kernel exponents, under which the frozen transformer emulates the classical Nadaraya-Watson kernel estimator. The construction requires only a mild rank condition on the weights, which we show holds almost surely under Gaussian initialization. The prompted network inherits the theoretical guarantees of kernel regression, leading to universal approximation theorems with minimax-optimal rates that depend on the intrinsic dimension. We further quantify the cost of prompting, exposing a tradeoff between the norm of the constructed soft prompt tokens, prompt length, and hidden dimension. Numerical experiments corroborate the constructions and predicted rates.

</details>


### [377] [Hyperbolic Multimodal Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09572)
*Jiahong Liu,Ming Shen,Xiaohao Liu,Rex Ying,Menglin Yang,Tat-Seng Chua,Irwin King*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从几何视角研究双曲空间中的多模态持续学习问题，建立了表征保持的理论基础，并提出了一种保持跨模态关系结构与层次几何的持续学习框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双曲几何近年来在多模态学习中展现出优势，但在持续学习场景下其表征行为尚未被充分探索，遗忘问题如何受双曲空间几何特性影响是一个开放问题。

Method: 理论上证明防止遗忘需要共享双曲等距变换下的跨模态不变性；分析出遗忘同时涉及语义关系漂移与层次相关失真；据此提出保持跨模态关系结构和层次几何的持续学习框架。

Result: 在持续多模态基准上的实验验证了所提方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 所提出的基于几何保持原则的持续学习框架能有效缓解双曲空间中的多模态遗忘问题。

Abstract: Hyperbolic geometry has recently emerged as a powerful representation space for multimodal learning, as it naturally captures hierarchical semantic structure across modalities. Despite this progress, how such representations behave under continual learning poses fundamentally different challenges that remain underexplored. This work provides a geometric perspective on this problem and establishes a theoretical foundation for representation preservation in hyperbolic space, showing that preventing forgetting requires cross-modal invariance under a shared hyperbolic isometry. We further show that forgetting in hyperbolic continual learning involves both semantic relation drift and hierarchy-related distortion, motivating preservation of both cross-modal relational structure and hierarchical geometry. Guided by these insights, a principled continual learning framework is derived that preserves essential geometric structure while allowing effective adaptation to new tasks. Experiments on continual multimodal benchmarks corroborate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [378] [LEED: Local Embedding Evolution Distance for over-smoothing estimation and virtual node selection in GNN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09596)
*Killian Cressant,Pedro B. Velloso*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LEED（局部嵌入演化距离），一种在节点级别量化图神经网络过平滑现象的新型局部度量指标，并通过其指导局部虚拟节点的构建以缓解过压缩问题，实验证明其在诊断和性能提升方面优于现有全局度量方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN存在过平滑（节点表示随层深趋于不可区分）和过压缩（长程信息通过有限消息传递通道被压缩）两大根本性缺陷。现有指标如Dirichlet能量仅能提供全局层面的过平滑刻画，缺乏节点级别的分辨率，无法分析节点级行为或指导架构改进。

Method: 提出LEED这一局部度量指标，通过追踪单个节点嵌入在层间的演化来量化过平滑。LEED在节点级别运作，能够揭示全局能量指标无法观测的异质性过平滑模式，并可生成节点重要性分数（嵌入驱动的中心性度量）。进一步利用LEED作为唯一标准指导局部虚拟节点的选择与构建，以缓解过压缩问题。

Result: 实验表明，LEED相比Dirichlet能量能提供更有信息量的诊断结果，同时保持全局评估能力；在虚拟节点集成方面更为有效，跨多个数据集提升了GNN性能。

Conclusion: LEED作为一种节点级别的局部度量，既能提供比全局能量方法更细粒度的过平滑诊断，又能作为单一准则高效指导虚拟节点构建以缓解过压缩，为GNN架构改进提供了新的工具和思路。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) suffer from two fundamental limitations: over-smoothing, where node representations become indistinguishable with depth, and over-squashing, where long-range information is compressed through limited message-passing channels. Existing metrics such as Dirichlet energy provide global characterizations of over-smoothing but lack the resolution to analyze node-level behavior and guide architectural improvements. In this paper, we propose LEED (Local Embedding Evolution Distance), a novel local metric that quantifies over-smoothing by tracking the evolution of individual node embeddings across layers. By operating at the node level, LEED enables fine-grained analysis of representation dynamics during training, revealing heterogeneous over-smoothing patterns that are invisible to global energy-based measures. This locality induces informative node importance scores, interpreted as embedding-driven centrality measures. We leverage LEED to design a more efficient strategy for virtual node selection. Unlike existing approaches that depend on multiple heuristic centrality measures, our method uses LEED as a unique criterion to guide the construction of Local Virtual Nodes to mitigate over-squashing. Experiments show that LEED provides more informative diagnostics than Dirichlet energy while preserving global evaluation, and enables more effective virtual node integration, improving GNN performance across datasets.

</details>


### [379] [Bayesian Symbolic Regression with Entropic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09617)
*Oussama Boussif,Mohammed Mahfoud,Younesse Kaddar,Moksh Jain,Sida Li,Damiano Fornasiere,Xiaoyin Chen,Yoshua Bengio,Esmeralda S. Whitammer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ERRLESS，一种基于最大熵强化学习的方法，用于从数据条件下的表达式后验分布中进行采样，实现贝叶斯符号回归，从而进行不确定性量化和自然先验约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统符号回归寻找单一的"最佳拟合"表达式，无法捕捉关于表达式本身的认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）。在自然科学中，数据通常有限且有噪声，贝叶斯视角能够提供不确定性量化和先验约束，但现有方法缺乏可扩展的后验采样方案。

Method: ERRLESS使用最大熵强化学习学习一个神经策略，该策略通过逐步构建抽象语法树（AST）来顺序生成表达式。收敛后，该策略能够从后验分布中采样表达式；测试时通过策略的rollout进行采样。

Result: 在Feynman基准测试上取得有竞争力的结果，同时生成简短且可解释的表达式；与SMC基线相比，ERRLESS近似得到的后验预测均值取得了更高的决定系数R²。

Conclusion: 基于最大熵强化学习的贝叶斯符号回归方法ERRLESS在可扩展性和性能上均表现出色，既能获得高质量的短表达式，又通过贝叶斯后验预测提升了预测精度，验证了贝叶斯视角在符号回归中的优势。

Abstract: Symbolic regression is the problem of finding an algebraic expression describing a stochastic dependence of a target variable on a set of inputs. Unlike forms of regression that fit parameters assuming a fixed model structure, symbolic regression is a search problem over the space of expressions, represented, for example, as abstract syntax trees using a library of operators. Symbolic regression is typically used in settings with limited, noisy data in the natural sciences. However, searching for a single best-fitting expression fails to capture the epistemic uncertainty about the expression, which motivates a Bayesian perspective that enables uncertainty quantification and specification of natural priors to constrain the search space. In this work, we propose ERRLESS (Entropy-Regularized Reinforcement Learning for Expression Structure Sampling), a scalable approach for sampling from the posterior distribution over expressions given data using maximum-entropy reinforcement learning. ERRLESS learns a neural policy that constructs expressions sequentially by building up their abstract syntax trees. At convergence, the policy samples expressions from the posterior. At test time, expressions can be sampled by rollouts of this policy. We demonstrate that ERRLESS achieves competitive results on the Feynman benchmark while producing short and interpretable expressions. Additionally, we demonstrate that the mean of the posterior predictive approximated by ERRLESS achieves a high coefficient of determination ($R^2$) compared to an SMC baseline, highlighting the benefits of the Bayesian perspective in symbolic regression.

</details>


### [380] [Satellite Trajectory Optimization via Proximal Policy Optimization for Space Debris Avoidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09628)
*Logan Luna,Juan Ortiz Couder,Raul Alejandro Vargas-Acosta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的航天器自主碰撞规避策略，使用PPO算法训练，配合开源高保真天体动力学模拟器进行训练和评估。在1000个确定性GEO场景中实现了97.5%的碰撞规避成功率，远超规则基线和脉冲变轨规划基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着巨型星座的发射，近地轨道和地球同步轨道的轨道拥堵日益严重，碎片碰撞事件频率不断增长。当前基于人工或规则驱动的碰撞规避方法难以扩展应对日益动态化的轨道环境，亟需可扩展的自主碰撞规避解决方案。

Method: 采用Proximal Policy Optimization（PPO）训练的强化学习策略进行自主碰撞规避。设计了开源高保真天体动力学模拟器，模拟牛顿二体动力学、日月三体摄动、燃料依赖推力和可配置碎片场。使用课程学习和塑形奖励，奖励函数鼓励航天器生存、足够的安全距离以及燃料节省。评估采用完全确定性流程，包括共享种子和遥测导出。

Result: 在1000个确定性GEO场景中，所提出的智能体达到97.5%的碰撞规避成功率，显著优于规则基线的20.7%和脉冲三角洲-v规划基线的27.5%成功率。

Conclusion: 强化学习方法在自主碰撞规避任务上展现出远超传统方法的性能，且整个框架已公开开源，为航天碰撞规避领域提供了可复现、可扩展的研究基础。

Abstract: Collision avoidance systems are commonly used to avoid fragmentation events occurring in Low-Earth Orbit (LEO) and Geosynchronous Equatorial Orbit (GEO). However, these events have been growing in frequency as orbital congestion worsens with the launch of megaconstellations. Consequently, conjunction alerts and collision risks are becoming increasingly common. Current practices, which are commonly manual or rule-based, have difficulty scaling to these worsening dynamic environments. To address this intensifying situation, we propose a reinforcement-learning policy for autonomous collision avoidance, trained via Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) along with an open-source, high-fidelity astrodynamics simulator for training and evaluation. In 1,000 deterministic GEO episodes, our agent achieves a 97.5% collision avoidance success rate, outperforming traditional controllers such as a rule-based baseline (20.7% success) and an impulsive delta-v planner baseline (27.5% success). To achieve these results, we designed a simulator to train and evaluate our agent, using real-world and simulated debris. We simulate Newtonian two-body dynamics using Sun/Moon third-body perturbations, fuel-dependent thrust, and configurable debris fields. The agent is trained with curriculum learning and shaped rewards oriented toward encouraging survival, adequate projected miss distance, and delta-v conservation. Finally, our evaluation consisted of a fully deterministic pipeline, including shared seeds, per-episode logs, and telemetry exports. Our work is a publicly available framework at https://purl.org/sat-trajectory-avoidance

</details>


### [381] [Deep Learning Imputation of Missing Radius of Maximum Winds (Rmax) Values in Tropical Cyclone Best-Track Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09683)
*Swastik Agrawal,Nishkal Hundia,Ziyue Liu,Michelle Bensi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究评估了多种数据驱动方法（1DCNN、LSTM及传统机器学习）用于热带气旋最大风速半径（Rmax）的缺失值填补，发现加入34节风速半径（R34）能显著提升性能，时间序列模型在样本量少约一个数量级的情况下仍能获得更高相关性，而基于合成数据集的迁移学习未能改善性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率性海岸灾害评估需要准确的热带气旋参数，但数据集中常缺失最大风速半径（Rmax）记录，而Rmax是联合概率方法分析中的关键变量，亟需有效的填补方法。

Method: 比较一维卷积神经网络（1DCNN）、长短期记忆网络（LSTM）和传统机器学习模型的填补性能；引入物理信息输入增强（R34）、时间建模，并使用合成RAFT和STORM数据集预训练加IBTrACS观测数据微调的迁移学习策略。

Result: 加入R34显著提升所有模型性能；时间模型在样本量少约一个数量级的条件下仍获得更高平均相关性，且当R34缺失时该优势更明显；迁移学习未提升性能，归因于合成数据集中Rmax分布偏低且变异更小。

Conclusion: 时间深度学习方法在重建不完整热带气旋记录方面具有潜力，物理信息输入、观测数据可用性和分布一致性对海岸灾害评估中Rmax填补至关重要。

Abstract: Probabilistic coastal hazard assessments require accurate characterization of tropical cyclone (TC) parameters, yet datasets often contain missing records for the radius of maximum winds (Rmax), a key variable in Joint Probability Method analyses. This study evaluates data-driven approaches for Rmax imputation, including one-dimensional Convolutional Neural Networks (1DCNNs), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, and conventional machine learning models. We examine physics-informed input augmentation, temporal modeling, and transfer learning using synthetic RAFT and STORM datasets for pre-training and observational IBTrACS data for fine-tuning. Including the radius of 34-knot winds (R34) substantially improves performance across all model types. Temporal models achieve higher average correlations than non-temporal models despite using approximately an order of magnitude fewer samples, indicating better preservation of relative Rmax variability across storms. This advantage is more pronounced when R34 is unavailable, suggesting temporal information can partially compensate for missing storm-size predictors. Transfer learning does not improve performance, likely because synthetic datasets have lower and less variable Rmax distributions than IBTrACS. These findings demonstrate the potential of temporal deep learning for reconstructing incomplete TC records and highlight the importance of physics-informed inputs, observational data availability, and distributional consistency in coastal hazard assessment.

</details>


### [382] [FedOrbit: Adaptive Personalized Federated Learning for Non-IID LEO Satellite Constellations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09687)
*Satwat Bashir,Tasos Dagiuklas,Muddesar Iqbal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedOrbit，一种针对LEO卫星星座联邦学习的框架，通过连续轨道级训练、类感知层次聚合、质量加权特征聚合和自适应特征分解，在遥感基准测试中显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LEO卫星星座中的联邦学习受非独立同分布（non-IID）数据和地面站可见性不规则的影响，传统全局聚合在轨道类分布不重叠时表现不佳，而过度个性化在分布重叠时又显得多余，需要一种自适应的方法来平衡二者。

Method: FedOrbit包含四个关键组件：1）通过星间链路进行连续轨道级训练；2）类感知的层次化聚合机制；3）带返回率阻尼的质量加权特征聚合；4）基于轨道间类别相似性的自适应特征分解。

Result: 在三个遥感基准和两种非IID分区设置下，FedOrbit在六种设置中的五种取得最高准确率，第六种与最优结果相差仅0.9个百分点。相比最强基线，在Dirichlet分区下提升达16.1个百分点，在病理性分区下提升8.6个百分点；在六种设置中的五种取得最小的每轨道准确率分散度。

Conclusion: FedOrbit有效应对了LEO星座FL中非IID数据与轨道几何带来的挑战，在准确性和一致性上均优于现有基线，证明了类感知层次聚合与自适应特征分解策略的有效性。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations is affected by non-IID data and irregular ground-station visibility, both driven by orbital geometry. Global aggregation performs poorly when orbit-level class distributions are disjoint, while strong personalisation can be excessive when these distributions overlap. We present FedOrbit, which combines continuous orbit-level training over inter-satellite links, class-aware hierarchical aggregation, quality-weighted feature aggregation with return-rate dampening, and adaptive feature decomposition based on inter-orbit class similarity. Across three remote-sensing benchmarks and two non-IID partitions, FedOrbit achieves the highest accuracy in five of six settings and is within $0.9$ percentage points of the best result in the sixth. The gains over the strongest baseline reach $16.1$ percentage points under Dirichlet partitioning and $8.6$ under pathological partitioning, with the smallest per-orbit accuracy spread in five of six settings.

</details>


### [383] [Confusion-Geometry Rebalancing for Long-Tailed Adversarial Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09688)
*Mengnan Zhao,Geyong Min,Lihe Zhang,Tianhang Zheng,Jie Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为CGRm（Confusion Geometry Rebalancing method）的即插即用框架，用于长尾分布下的对抗训练。该方法利用有向鲁棒误差作为训练信号，通过周期性的鲁棒评估推导出源类损失权重、类级鲁棒系数和有向混淆几何图，并将反馈加权鲁棒优化与图引导的边际校正相结合，以增强脆弱类的鲁棒性并锐化关键决策边界，在长尾基准上取得了优于现有方法的一致性性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长尾分布下的对抗训练面临双重不平衡问题：类不平衡使训练目标偏向头部类别，而对抗内层最大化可能进一步放大这种偏差。现有方法通过修正类先验或调整类级鲁棒监督来缓解问题，但它们将每个类别孤立处理，未能识别出导致长尾性能崩溃的关键决策边界。

Method: CGRm是一个即插即用框架，核心包括：（1）利用周期性的鲁棒评估来推导源类损失权重和类级鲁棒系数；（2）构建有向混淆几何图以刻画类别间的鲁棒误差传播关系；（3）将反馈加权鲁棒优化与图引导的边际校正耦合，从而增强脆弱类的鲁棒性并强化导致长尾性能退化的关键边界。

Result: 在多个长尾基准数据集上的实验表明，CGRm相对于现有方法取得了一致的鲁棒性能提升，消融实验验证了各组件（源类损失权重、类级鲁棒系数、有向混淆几何图）的贡献。

Conclusion: CGRm通过显式建模类间混淆几何关系，而非将类别孤立处理，有效解决了长尾对抗训练中的双重不平衡问题，为长尾场景下的鲁棒学习提供了一种新的范式。

Abstract: Adversarial training under long tailed distributions suffers from a dual imbalance: the class imbalance skews the training objective toward head classes, and the adversarial inner maximization may further amplify this bias. Existing methods mitigate this issue by correcting class priors or adapting class wise robust supervision, yet they treat each class in isolation and fail to identify which boundaries drive long tailed collapse. We propose a Confusion Geometry Rebalancing method (CGRm) for long tail adversarial training, a plug in framework that leverages directed robust errors as training signals. CGRm leverages periodic robust evaluations to derive source class loss weights, class wise robust coefficients, and a directed confusion geometry graph. The method then couples feedback weighted robust optimization with graph guided margin correction, thereby boosting the robustness of vulnerable classes and sharpening the critical boundaries that drive long tailed performance degradation. Experiments on long tailed benchmarks show that CGRm achieves consistent robust performance gains over existing methods, with ablations validating the contribution of each component. We provide the code in the supplement.

</details>


### [384] [Recurrent Neural Networks Beyond Time: Learning from Multiple Ordered Projections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09690)
*Vagan Terziyan,Artur Terziian,Oleksandra Vitko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了有序结构依赖假说（OSDH）和独立结构专家原则（ISEP），并据此设计了结构演化RNN（SE-RNNs）。该方法通过多个投影特定的序列模型独立训练后融合集成，利用同一观测数据的多种可行排序来揭示单一序列组织无法获取的互补结构依赖关系。在三个不同结构复杂度的合成数据集上验证了该方法在存在隐藏结构依赖时的一致性优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统观点认为RNN主要适用于时间序列数据，但作者指出循环计算本质上作用于有序序列而非时间本身。基于此观察，作者希望探索同一观测数据的多种可行排序是否能揭示互补的结构依赖关系，从而超越单一序列组织的表达能力。

Method: 提出OSDH假说（多种有序排列可揭示互补的结构依赖）和ISEP原则（投影特定的序列模型独立训练后通过融合模型集成）。具体实现为SE-RNNs，使用传统RNN作为投影特定的结构专家，保持底层循环计算不变，多个专家独立训练后通过专用融合模型整合其学习表示。

Result: 在三个不同结构复杂度的合成数据集上，SE-RNNs在存在隐藏结构依赖时一致受益于多个有序投影，同时在较简单数据集上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: OSDH独立于底层序列处理模型，框架可自然扩展到循环网络之外的替代架构。结果揭示了利用互补有序表示进行多样化结构化学习问题的通用计算视角。

Abstract: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are widely used for sequence learning, yet their application is commonly associated with temporal data, although recurrent computation fundamentally operates on ordered sequences rather than on time itself. Building on this observation, we introduce the Ordered Structural Dependency Hypothesis (OSDH), which proposes that multiple admissible orderings of the same observations may reveal complementary structural dependencies inaccessible through a single sequential organization. To operationalize this hypothesis, we propose the Independent Structural Expert Principle (ISEP), whereby projection-specific sequence models are trained independently before their learned representations are integrated through a dedicated fusion model. As a concrete realization, we present Structural Evolution RNNs (SE-RNNs), which employ conventional RNNs as projection-specific structural experts while preserving the underlying recurrent computation unchanged. Proof-of-concept experiments on three synthetic datasets with substantially different levels of structural complexity demonstrate that the proposed architecture consistently benefits from multiple ordered projections when hidden structural dependencies are present, while remaining competitive on simpler datasets. Since OSDH is independent of the underlying sequence-processing model, the proposed framework naturally extends beyond recurrent networks and may be instantiated using alternative architectures. The results suggest a general computational perspective for exploiting complementary ordered representations across diverse structured learning problems.

</details>


### [385] [Evaluating Generative Time-Series Models on Data with Point Masses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09692)
*Jian Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了生成式时间序列模型基准测试中因数据含有大量单一值（如零）而导致的严重评估问题：标准滚动起点协议可能产生与数据集结构完全不符的评估窗口，极大影响模型排序结论；作者提供了构造性对照实验、对七种模型在匹配协议下的系统比较，并发现不同发生统计量会导致不同的模型排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多生成式时间序列模型的基准数据将大量概率质量集中在单一值上（如无降雨、无订单等），但现有评估协议未能充分考虑这一特殊数据结构，可能导致误导性的模型对比结论。

Method: (1) 检查标准滚动起点协议在含零值数据上的评估窗口与数据集本身的原子结构偏差；(2) 构造一个CRPS不变但时间耦合被破坏的对照实验，以量化时间耦合对统计量的贡献；(3) 在匹配协议下、五种随机种子下对七种模型进行基准测试；(4) 比较五种不同的发生统计量下的模型排序一致性。

Result: 滚动起点协议使评估窗口的零值比例与数据集严重不符（如42%对13%），甚至反转了作者之前的结论；自回归hurdle模型在六个数据集中的五个上超越条件流模型最多达153倍，而流的发生统计量跨训练种子波动高达62%；不同发生统计量下的模型排序不一致，构造方式不共享的两个统计量一致性最差。

Conclusion: 时间序列基准测试中发生（occurrence）结构的评估至关重要，标准协议可能产生系统性偏差，必须使用匹配的评估协议并谨慎选择发生统计量，否则模型对比结论可能被严重扭曲。

Abstract: Many of the series that generative time-series models are benchmarked on place a large probability mass on a single value --- it does not rain, no ride is requested, no part is ordered. We report what happens when such data is evaluated carefully. First, the standard rolling-origin protocol can score a model on a window whose atom structure bears no resemblance to the dataset: on one benchmark the dataset is $42\%$ zeros and the evaluation windows are $13\%$, on another $47\%$ against $5\%$. This is not a cosmetic problem --- it reversed one of our own conclusions, turning the strongest occurrence model in our study into what looked like a cautionary tale. Second, we give a control in which CRPS is invariant \emph{by construction} while the temporal coupling is destroyed, which measures exactly how much that coupling contributes to a chosen statistic. Third, benchmarking seven models on a matched protocol over five seeds, an autoregressive hurdle beats a conditional flow on five of six datasets, by up to a factor of $153$, while the flow's own occurrence statistics vary by up to $62\%$ across training seeds and every baseline is deterministic. Finally, the model ordering is not the same under five different occurrence statistics, and the two that do not share a construction agree with each other least.

</details>


### [386] [PET/CT Radiogenomic Mutation Prediction in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Using Multi-Label Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09721)
*Mona Furukawa,Sai Hyne,Daniel R. McGowan,Bartłomiej W. Papież*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究首次系统探索在PET/CT影像基因组学中利用深度学习进行EGFR、TP53和KRAS基因突变的成对多标签联合预测，并在英国肺癌队列中发现多标签学习的效果取决于具体基因组合：KRAS/TP53联合预测能提升AUC，而EGFR/TP53组合则无改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肺癌死亡率高，靶向治疗依赖有创组织活检的突变检测，需要开发基于PET/CT的无创影像基因组学预测方法，并探索多标签学习是否优于传统的单基因分类。

Method: 基于UK新型放射基因组学队列，使用深度学习对PET/CT影像进行EGFR、TP53和KRAS三种基因突变的预测，并比较成对多标签学习与传统单基因分类的效果。

Result: KRAS/TP53联合预测使KRAS AUC从0.58提升至0.64，TP53从0.69提升至0.71；EGFR/KRAS组合仅EGFR受益；EGFR/TP53组合无改善。

Conclusion: 多标签学习的有效性依赖于具体突变的基因组合，建议针对特定基因突变采用定制化的建模策略进行PET/CT影像基因组学预测。

Abstract: Lung cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer- related mortality worldwide. Although targeted therapies have improved outcomes for patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), they rely on mutation profiling through tissue biopsy, an invasive procedure with several limitations. This study investigates PET/CT-based radio- genomic prediction of epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR), tumour protein 53 (TP53), and Kirsten rat sarcoma viral oncogene (KRAS) mutations using deep learning. We further evaluate whether pairwise multi-label learning improves mutation prediction compared with conventional single-gene classification. To the best of our knowledge, this is among the first studies to systematically investigate multi-label learning for PET/CT radiogenomic mutation prediction in NSCLC. Experiments were conducted on a novel UK-based radiogenomics cohort. Joint pre- diction of KRAS and TP53 improved AUC from 0.58 to 0.64 for KRAS and from 0.69 to 0.71 for TP53. For the EGFR/KRAS pair, only EGFR benefited from joint learning, while no improvement was observed for the EGFR/TP53 pair. These findings demonstrate that the effectiveness of multi-label learning depends on the specific combination of gene mutations being modelled, suggesting that mutation-specific modelling strategies may be preferable for PET/CT radiogenomic prediction.

</details>


### [387] [Rethinking Factor Sharing in Federated LoRA: A Rank-Aware Adaptive Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09742)
*Xinyi Xu,Bingnan Xiao,Shuang Qin,Gang Feng,Tony Q. S. Quek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedAS-LoRA，一种用于联邦学习场景下大语言模型微调的LoRA因子共享策略自适应选择方法。通过分析LoRA中A和B因子的不对称角色，作者揭示了Share-A/Local-B与Share-B/Local-A两种策略的本质差异在于投影残差不同，并设计RSS指标在训练前自动选择更优的共享策略，从而提升联邦微调性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在联邦学习中微调大语言模型时，LoRA因子的共享方式（共享A或共享B）对性能有显著影响，但现有方法缺乏对此的理论分析与自适应选择机制。作者希望通过理论洞察找到最优的共享策略。

Method: 首先通过最小二乘代理模型理论分析两种共享策略（Share-A/Local-B与Share-B/Local-A）的投影残差差异；据此提出FedAS-LoRA框架，并设计Rank-Aware Shared-Subspace Sufficiency（RSS）指标，利用冻结的LLM骨干提取的表示来预训练评估共享rank-r输入子空间是否足以覆盖本地数据分布，从而在训练前完成共享侧的自适应选择。

Result: 在多种任务、数据分布、LoRA秩和参与率设置下的实验表明，RSS指标能有效指导共享策略选择，FedAS-LoRA在所有测试场景中均表现出优于基线的联邦微调性能。

Conclusion: LoRA因子的共享侧选择不应是固定的，而应根据客户端数据分布自适应决定。FedAS-LoRA结合理论分析与数据驱动的RSS指标，在训练前即可确定最优共享策略，为联邦LoRA微调提供了实用且高效的新方案。

Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) represents large language model (LLM) updates with two compact matrix factors, i.e., $A$ and $B$, providing an efficient way to fine-tune large models in federated learning paradigm. Inspired by the asymmetric roles of the LoRA factors, we study whether $A$ should be shared across clients while $B$ remains client-specific (Share-A/Local-B), or whether $B$ should instead be shared while $A$ remains client-specific (Share-B/Local-A). With a least-squares surrogate, we reveal that Share-A/Local-B requires the client-specific LoRA update matrices to use a common rank-$r$ input-side space, whereas Share-B/Local-A requires a common rank-$r$ output-side space. The two strategies therefore incur different projection residuals, indicating that the preferred strategy is the one with the smaller aggregate residual across clients. With this insight, we propose Federated Adaptive Factor Sharing Low-Rank Adaptation (FedAS-LoRA), which selects the sharing side before training to enhance fine-tuning performance. To enable adaptive factor selection before training, we design a Rank-Aware Shared-Subspace Sufficiency (RSS) metric, which effectively assesses whether a shared rank-$r$ input subspace is sufficient for the local data distributions using representations extracted from a frozen LLM backbone. Experiments across different tasks, data distributions, LoRA ranks, and participation settings confirm the effectiveness of RSS and the superior performance of FedAS-LoRA.

</details>


### [388] [SR-OPSD: Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09745)
*Zhuo Sun,Entong Li,Yanlong Zhao,Xiaoyuan Cheng,Wenxuan Yuan,Kaiyu Li,Che Liu,Huihang Liu,Harrison Bo Hua Zhu,Li Zeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自引用在线策略自蒸馏（SR-OPSD）方法，针对在线策略自蒸馏中"移动目标"导致优化不稳定的问题，通过变分表征将蒸馏目标识别为自教师策略与参考策略之间的几何插值，并利用Rényi散度族泛化投影几何，从而分离"目标位置"与"投影方式"两个维度，在科学评估、数学推理和代码生成等多个任务上取得最优或具有竞争力的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）利用策略自身生成的轨迹提供密集的token级监督，是稀疏结果奖励强化学习的有效补充。然而，OPSD中的自教师策略随学生策略及其on-policy上下文分布共同演化，是一个"移动目标"。直接以固定投影目标匹配这种动态目标会导致优化不稳定或过度的分布集中，因此需要更稳健的自蒸馏框架。

Method: SR-OPSD包含两方面核心设计：(1) 在固定的学生生成上下文中，通过token级变分表征将有效蒸馏目标识别为自教师策略与参考策略之间的几何插值，用插值系数控制底层目标的位置；(2) 引入Rényi散度族泛化投影几何，用Rényi阶数控制投影方式及其对token级密度比的敏感性。这种设计将"目标放在哪里"与"如何向目标投影"两个问题解耦。

Result: 在科学评估、数学推理和代码生成任务上，使用多种大语言模型进行广泛实验，SR-OPSD在多种设置下均达到最先进或具有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: SR-OPSD通过将自适应目标的位置与投影几何分离，有效解决了OPSD中移动目标导致的优化不稳定问题，并在多个下游任务上验证了其有效性，为在线策略自蒸馏提供了更稳健和灵活的框架。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) converts feedback into dense token-level supervision on trajectories generated by the policy to be optimized, providing a useful complement to reinforcement learning with sparse outcome rewards. However, the self-teacher policy used in OPSD is typically a stop-gradient or exponential-moving-average copy of the policy conditioned on additional context information, and thus co-evolves with both the student policy and its on-policy context distribution. Directly matching such a moving target with a fixed projection objective can lead to unstable optimization or excessive distributional concentration. This nature of OPSD motivates the proposed \emph{Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation (SR-OPSD)}. At fixed student-generated contexts, a token-level variational characterization identifies the effective distillation target as a geometric interpolation between the self-teacher policy and a reference policy. Meanwhile, we use the Rényi divergence family to generalize the projection geometry. This formulation separates \emph{where} the adaptive target is placed from \emph{how} the student is projected toward it: the interpolation coefficient controls underlying target, while the Rényi order controls the projection geometry and its sensitivity to token-level density ratios. Extensive experiments across scientific evaluation, mathematical reasoning, and coding generation tasks with multiple large language models show that SR-OPSD achieves the state-of-the-art or competitive performance across various settings.

</details>


### [389] [MoNo: Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator for Solving PDEs on General Geometries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09764)
*Zijiang Yang,Xiaomeng Wu,Dongmei Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MoNo（多尺度最优传输神经算子），通过CoTAP（跨尺度最优传输分配与投影）方法解决Transformer神经算子在潜空间中令牌分配不平衡和层级塌缩的问题，在通用几何上高效求解PDE，实验证明其在预测性能和计算效率上均优于现有最先进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Transformer神经算子的可学习投影机制无法保证观测点到潜令牌的稳定均衡分配，导致部分令牌过度分配而其他令牌利用不足。这种分配不平衡会随层级结构逐级继承和放大，最终在深层潜空间中引发严重的令牌塌缩，限制了层级架构的设计与预测效果。

Method: 提出CoTAP方法，将相邻潜空间之间的跨空间分配建模为带熵正则化的最优传输问题，构建平衡双向投影和稳定的潜空间；基于CoTAP设计MoNo，一种渐进式多尺度神经算子，在通用几何上实现稳定的潜空间构建和跨尺度信息传递，支持多尺度架构以高效学习长程物理交互。

Result: 大量实验表明，MoNo在预测性能和计算效率两方面均超越了现有的最先进神经算子方法。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 通过将跨尺度分配问题形式化为正则化最优传输，可以有效解决神经算子中令牌分配不平衡和深层令牌塌缩问题，为实现通用几何上稳定、高效的多尺度PDE求解提供了新思路。

Abstract: Transformer-based neural operators have achieved substantial progress in solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) by projecting spatial observations into compact latent tokens and learning physical interactions in latent spaces. However, we reveal that existing learnable projection mechanisms cannot ensure stable and balanced assignments from observation points to latent tokens, causing some latent tokens to be over-assigned while others remain underutilized. This limitation further restricts the design of hierarchical architectures, as assignment imbalance is continuously inherited and amplified across latent spaces, eventually causing severe token collapse in deeper spaces. To address these issues, we propose MoNo (Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator), a progressive multiscale neural operator that efficiently solves PDEs on general geometries through stable latent-space construction. At its core is CoTAP (Cross-scale Optimal Transport Assignment and Projection), a novel latent-space construction method that formulates cross-space assignment between adjacent spaces as an entropy-regularized optimal transport problem, thereby constructing balanced bidirectional projections and stable latent spaces. CoTAP also ensures stable information transfer across multiple latent spaces, further enabling multiscale architectures on general geometries, which in turn support more efficient learning of long-range physical interactions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MoNo outperforms existing state-of-the-art neural operators in both prediction performance and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/ZijiangY1116/MoNo.

</details>


### [390] [ReliableNet: A Chance-Constrained Approach to Trustworthy Classification in Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09768)
*Ange-Clément Akazan,Ineza Remy Mugenga,Abebe Geletu,Jean Medard Ngnotchouye,Issa Karambal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ReliableNet方法，通过约束"自信且错误"（JCW）联合概率在用户指定的风险预算内，解决模型过度自信但判断错误的关键可靠性问题。该方法将问题建模为机会约束ERM，并使用保守光滑内逼近求解。在四个表格和两个图像数据集上，ReliableNet是唯一在所有数据集和种子下均满足JCW预算的方法，并在分布偏移场景下取得最低经验JCW，同时保持竞争性的准确率、覆盖率、校准和选择性预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一个自信但错误的预测是严重可靠性缺陷，因为当模型恰好犯错时，它可能绕过弃权和人工审查。现有方法（ERM、校准、不确定性估计、共形风险控制、选择性预测）只控制相关可靠性属性，并未在训练过程中直接限制联合失败事件的发生概率。

Method: 将约束"自信且错误"（JCW）概率低于用户指定的风险预算α这一问题建模为机会约束ERM问题，并使用保守光滑内逼近方法求解，其群体可行性蕴含原始JCW约束。

Result: 在四个表格和两个图像数据集上，ReliableNet是唯一在所有数据集和种子下均在分布内满足JCW预算的方法。在人口统计学、模糊性、虚假关联、新类别和协变量偏移下，它取得最低的经验JCW，同时在准确率、覆盖率、校准和选择性预测方面保持很强的竞争力。风险覆盖结果表明其在大多数数据集上取得了更好的选择性排序。

Conclusion: ReliableNet为可信分类提供了一种原则性的方法，能够有效约束模型自信但错误的联合失败事件，兼顾可靠性与其他性能指标。

Abstract: A prediction that is both confident and wrong is a critical reliability failure because it can bypass abstention and human review precisely when the model is mistaken. Empirical risk minimization (ERM) controls average loss but not this failure directly, while calibration, uncertainty estimation, conformal risk control, and selective prediction methods target related reliability properties rather than bounding the joint failure event during training. We propose ReliableNet, which constrains the Joint Confident-Wrong (JCW) probability, the probability that a prediction is simultaneously confident and incorrect, below a user-specified risk budget $α\in(0,1)$. We formulate this as a chance-constrained ERM problem, use a conservative smooth inner approximation whose population feasibility implies the original JCW constraint. Across four tabular and two image datasets, ReliableNet is the only method certified within the JCW budget for every dataset and seed in distribution, when compared against baselines spanning ERM, post-hoc calibration, conformal risk control, and selective prediction. Under demographic, ambiguity, spurious-correlation, novel-class, and covariate shifts, it achieves the lowest empirical JCW among the compared methods while remaining very competitive in accuracy, coverage, calibration, and selective prediction. Risk-coverage results further indicate that ReliableNet achieves better selective ranking than the benchmark methods on most datasets. Overall, ReliableNet provides a principled approach to trustworthy classification.

</details>


### [391] [Parameter Exploration for RLVR via Variational Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09805)
*Vatsal Venkatkrishna,Nico Daheim,Iryna Gurevych*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一族名为Perturbed Parameter Policy Optimization (3PO)的参数空间探索方法，通过在训练时从后验中采样不同参数的策略生成rollout，以补充传统的动作空间探索。在OLMo-3-1025-7B和Qwen2.5-Math-7B上的数学推理和代码生成任务中，3PO相比标准GRPO在近相同计算成本下持续提升平均下游性能，并减少了零优势组和格式错误的rollout。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM强化学习探索方法主要作用于动作空间（如温度缩放），这类方法无法重新排序token，只能影响输出分布的方差，限制了探索能力，可能导致训练发散或停滞。因此需要探索参数空间的探索机制作为补充控制手段。

Method: 提出3PO方法族，其核心思想是从策略的后验分布中采样不同参数的策略来生成rollouts，通过采用不同的采样策略和不同的rollout分组方式来进行奖励估计，从而实现对探索程度的多样化控制。

Result: 在数学推理和代码生成任务上，3PO方法在接近相同的FLOPs成本下持续优于标准GRPO的平均下游性能；此外，使用多个参数样本训练时产生的零优势组、格式错误或错误的rollout显著少于GRPO和动作空间基线方法。

Conclusion: 参数空间探索能够有效改善LLM的强化学习效果，是一种与动作空间探索互补且有价值的研究方向。

Abstract: Exploration has been a focus of reinforcement learning research for a long time. Recently, there has been growing evidence that it is also an important ingredient in LLM reinforcement learning recipes that can significantly impact downstream performance. Many existing methods control exploration in the action-space, for example, using temperature scaling. However, these methods cannot reorder tokens but only influence the variance in the output distribution. This limits exploration and can lead to divergence or stalled training. Here, we investigate parameter-space exploration, where rollouts are generated by sampling different policies from a posterior that may each explore different rollouts. Sampling less or more diverse policies is then a complementary control lever over exploration. We introduce a family of methods called Perturbed Parameter Policy Optimization (3PO) which use different sampling strategies and different rollout grouping for reward estimation. Experiments on OLMo-3-1025-7B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks show that these approaches consistently improve average downstream performance over standard GRPO at a near-identical FLOPs cost. Moreover, using multiple parameter samples consistently produces fewer zero-advantage groups and malformed or incorrect rollouts during training than GRPO and action-space baselines. Overall, our work presents evidence that parameter-space exploration can improve reinforcement learning for LLMs.

</details>


### [392] [Macaron-V1: Towards Open Continual Learning with Self-Improvement and Mixture-of-LoRA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09819)
*Mind Lab,:,Vin Bo,Asher Cai,Jingwei Cao,Song Cao,Vic Cao,Amelia Chen,Andrew Chen,Kaijie Chen,Cleon Cheng,Steven Chiang,Kaixuan Fan,Hera Feng,Huan Feng,Arthur Fu,Jun Gao,Pyke Han,Nolan Ho,Ori Hong,Hailee Hou,Piers Hua,Charles Huang,Miles Jiang,Nora Jiang,Yuyi Jiang,Qiuyu Jin,Fancy Kong,Kuss Koo,Jaron Lee,Andrew Lei,Alexy Li,Dawn Li,Lucian Li,Ray Li,Ricardo Li,Smith Li,Theo Li,Allen Lin,Elliot Lin,Fan Lin,Chen Ling,Kairus Liu,Kieran Liu,Logan Liu,Neo Liu,Xiang Liu,Yuxin Lu,Maeve Luo,Pony Ma,Verity Niu,Cole Qiao,Guian Qiu,Vince Qu,Sentry,Niko Song,Vincent Wang,Bo Wu,Rio Yang,Evelyn Ye,Fiona Ye,Ina Ye,Regis Ye,Josh Ying,Atlas Zeng,Danney Zeng,Salmon Zhan,Anya Zhang,Di Zhang,Mia Zhang,Sueky Zhang,Wei Zhao,Ada Zhou,Adrian Zhou,Yuhua Zhou,Juno Zhu,Murphy Zhuang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Macaron-V1是一个面向"经验智能"的开放智能体模型家族，通过递归自改进的模型-框架配对实现持续学习，并采用Mixture-of-LoRA（MoL）架构实现协作，在多个基准上对标前沿模型进行了评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统模型在部署后无法持续从真实环境经验中学习，缺乏适应性和协作能力。本文旨在构建一个能够从经验中学习、并在部署后持续改进的智能体模型系统。

Method: 围绕两大系统目标设计：(1) 适应——通过递归改进版本化的模型-框架配对，在外部契约下评估经验并构建后继版本；(2) 协作——采用Mixture-of-LoRA（MoL）架构，冻结基础模型，组合专家LoRA适配器，每轮用户交互选择一个LoRA。旗舰版Macaron-V1-Venti基于744B GLM-5.2基础模型搭配四个LoRA（对话、智能体、编程、GenUI）；Macaron-V1-Tall基于Qwen3.6（50B）用于本地部署。算法层面包括Model-Harness Co-design、递归自改进循环、UI4A组件原生GenUI框架、状态化动作基座、版本化HCP契约及MindForge智能体强化学习框架。基础设施包括MinT后训练平台、LongStraw长上下文RL方法及稀疏MoE和DSA基础模型的稳定性技术。

Result: 在Personal Intelligence、GenUI和通用能力基准上对Macaron-V1进行了评估，并与前沿基线模型对比。结果验证了当前系统的有效性。

Conclusion: 当前系统已得到验证，但从持续学习和集体智能中获得的复合收益仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Macaron-V1 is an open agent-model family for experiential intelligence: learning from experience in real environments and continuing to learn after deployment. It is organized around two system goals. Adaptation is pursued through recursive improvement of versioned model-harness pairs, where experience from one configuration is evaluated under an external contract and used to construct its successor. Collaboration is pursued via the Mixture-of-LoRA (MoL) architecture that freezes a base model, composes specialist LoRA adapters, and selects one LoRA per user turn. The flagship Macaron-V1-Venti combines a 744B GLM-5.2 base with four LoRAs for chat, agent, coding, and GenUI; the Qwen3.6-based Macaron-V1-Tall (50B) uses the same design for local deployment. This report presents Macaron-V1 as a co-designed system spanning architecture, algorithms, and infrastructure. The MoL architecture supports continual learning through extensible LoRA specialists. The algorithm combines Model-Harness Co-design and recursive self-improvement loop, including the UI4A component-native GenUI harness, a stateful action substrate, versioned HCP contract, and the agentic RL framework MindForge. The supporting infrastructure includes the post-training platform MinT, the long-context RL method LongStraw, and stability techniques for sparse MoE and DSA base models. We evaluate Macaron-V1 on Personal Intelligence, GenUI, and general capability benchmarks against frontier baselines. Our results validate the current system, while compounding gains from continual learning and collective intelligence remain open questions.

</details>


### [393] [Distill Skills into Weights, Not Prompts: Abstract Skills as Privileged Signals for On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09826)
*Yubo Jiang,Fengying Xie,Zhiguo Jiang,Haopeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SKALD（技能锚定潜在蒸馏）框架，解决强化学习在rollout组全对或全错时缺乏组间相对信号的问题（占63-68%的实验组）。SKALD利用同一Qwen3-Base模型的两个上下文视图，让仅含问题的学生模型从条件化技能卡片的教师模型中蒸馏学习，在不引入推理时特权输入的情况下传递技能优势。实验表明，SKALD在五个数学基准上显著优于GRPO，且零方差蒸馏能恢复84.7%的完整增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准的基于可验证奖励的强化学习（如GRPO）依赖组内相对信号来估计优势，但当rollout组内所有样本全对或全错时（占63-68%），组间相对信号消失，导致奖励稀疏且无信息量，限制了策略优化效率。

Method: SKALD是一种on-policy自蒸馏框架，包含：(1) 两个上下文视图：仅含问题的学生模型和以抽象技能卡片（用显式答案过滤生成）为条件的教师模型；(2) 使用学生自身前缀进行训练，将技能优势迁移至共享参数；(3) 采用退火指数倾斜目标函数，降低教师偏好但学生似然极低的token权重，倾斜项消失后收敛为教师交叉熵并恢复前向KL学生梯度；(4) 经验门控机制，仅在验证rollout估计出正向教师优势时激活蒸馏。

Result: 在五个数学基准上，SKALD在0.6B、1.7B和4B规模下分别比GRPO提升avg@8达+2.46、+4.85和+12.01。在1.7B规模下，仅用零方差蒸馏可恢复84.7%的完整增益；SKALD比FLOP匹配的GRPO高+4.06，比上下文技能暴露方法高+3.77。

Conclusion: 抽象技能在组相对奖励失效时提供了密集监督信号，SKALD通过蒸馏机制成功地将技能优势编码进共享参数，在多个规模下均超越了GRPO基线，验证了该方法在数学推理任务中的有效性和可扩展性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards yields no group-relative signal when rollout groups are uniformly correct or uniformly wrong, which account for 63.0-68.0% of groups in our experiments. We propose SKALD (Skill-Anchored Latent Distillation), an on-policy self-distillation framework that uses two context views of the same Qwen3-Base model: a question-only student and a teacher conditioned on an abstract, explicit-answer-filtered skill card. The student is trained on its own prefixes, transferring the skill-induced advantage into shared parameters without privileged input at test time. To stabilize context-induced distribution mismatch, SKALD employs an annealed exponentially tilted objective that downweights teacher-preferred tokens with very low student likelihood; as the tilt vanishes, it converges to teacher cross-entropy and recovers the forward-KL student gradient. An empirical gate activates distillation only when verified rollouts estimate a positive teacher advantage. Across five held-out mathematics benchmarks, SKALD improves overall avg@8 over GRPO by +2.46, +4.85, and +12.01 at 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B, respectively. At 1.7B, zero-variance-only distillation recovers 84.7% of the full gain, while SKALD remains +4.06 above FLOP-matched GRPO and exceeds contextual skill exposure by +3.77. These results show that abstract skills provide dense supervision where group-relative rewards become uninformative.

</details>


### [394] [Multi-Agent AI Safety as an Institutional Design Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09828)
*Abdullah X*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是POLIS研究计划的首篇论文，通过5,280个冻结回合的研究套件，系统性地考察多智能体系统中AI制度（规则、权限状态、执行机制）的不同组成部分如何影响安全性。研究发现：详细的宪法性提示和可追溯来源的执行守卫均实现0/384违规，但后者会阻止部分尝试；局部状态守卫在权限来源不变而可见策略变化的场景中失效；来源追踪在洗钱场景中显著优于局部状态守卫（p = 4.77×10⁻⁷）；揭示配额数值会改变智能体请求行为。核心结论是：规则本身只是制度的一部分，系统信任的权威状态和阻断后的路径同样关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究已表明部署规则能改变多智能体系统的集体行为，但尚未系统性地回答"AI制度的哪些部分产生安全性"以及"它们如何产生安全性"这一根本问题。作者希望通过分解制度的组成部分（规则表述、权威状态、执行守卫、回退路径）来理解安全性的来源。

Method: 采用预注册的实验设计，构建5,280个冻结回合的研究套件。主要委派实验覆盖4个模型家族，另加3个模型端点用于高冲突诊断。实验在不同规则表述和权威状态下进行配对结构化工作流测试，同时变化合规内部回退的吸引力，并允许被阻断的工作流继续执行。此外还设计了资源分配实验和洗钱场景测试。

Result: 详细的宪法性提示产生0/384违规；可追溯来源的执行守卫同样产生0/384违规（在51/384个回合中阻止了被禁止的尝试，其中44个回合后续安全完成）；局部状态守卫在来源不变但策略可见变化的场景中失败；在洗钱场景中局部状态守卫在22/96个回合中允许违规，而来源追踪守卫为0/96（p = 4.77×10⁻⁷）；资源分配实验显示揭示数值上限会改变请求行为。

Conclusion: 相同的最终违规率可能隐藏完全不同的机制。AI制度的安全不仅取决于规则本身，还取决于系统信任的权威状态（具体是局部可见策略还是来源追踪）以及阻断后可用的替代路径。制度设计需要综合考虑规则的表述、权威状态的选择和阻断后的回退机制。

Abstract: AI agents increasingly work inside systems that govern how they delegate tasks, move information, execute actions, and use shared resources. Recent work already shows that deployment rules can change collective behavior. Here we ask which parts of an AI institution produce safety and how they do it. This is the first paper from POLIS, an ongoing research programme studying algorithmic institutions for multi-agent systems. We report a frozen 5,280-episode study suite. The main pre-specified delegation experiment spans four model families; a targeted high-conflict diagnostic adds three additional model endpoints. In matched structured workflows, the model sees different rule formulations and guards consult different authority states. We also vary the attractiveness of the immediate compliant internal/self fallback and allow blocked workflows to continue. A detailed constitutional prompt produces 0/384 realized violations. A provenance-aware executable guard also produces 0/384, although it blocks prohibited attempts in 51/384 episodes; 44/51 of those episodes later complete safely. The local-state guard's failures concentrate in scenarios where an ordinary transformation changes visible policy while originating authority stays fixed. In matched laundering scenarios, that guard admits violations in 22/96 episodes and provenance enforcement in 0/96 (p = 4.77 x 10^-7). A separate resource-allocation experiment shows that revealing the numerical value of an otherwise identical cap changes agent requests. In these structured workflows, the same final violation rate can hide very different mechanisms. The rule itself is only part of the institution. The authority state the system trusts matters, and so does the path available after a block.

</details>


### [395] [Deep Multimodal Wearable Sensor Fusion for Detection of Body-Focused Repetitive Behaviors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09830)
*Samaneh Rezaeimanesh,Mohsen Behradfar,Mohammad Fili,Guiping Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于腕戴式传感器数据和多模态深度学习框架（CNN+GRU、模态自编码器与晚期融合分类器）的方法，用于客观检测和分类身体聚焦重复行为（如拔毛发、抓皮肤）。在二元检测中F1达0.985、AUC达0.997；九类分类中宏平均F1达0.700、AUC达0.963。可解释性分析表明飞行时间与惯性模态贡献最大，聚类分析显示误分类主要由手势的解剖区域驱动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 身体聚焦重复行为（如拔毛发、抓皮肤）常见于强迫症和焦虑障碍，但因其动作细微且与常规非病理性手势重叠，早期客观检测十分困难，亟需一种有效的自动检测方法。

Method: 利用儿童心理研究所Helios腕戴设备采集的IMU、热电堆和飞行时间传感器数据，结合CNN与GRU网络、模态特定自编码器及晚期融合分类器，构建多模态深度学习框架实现行为检测与分类，并采用Shapley加性解释进行事后可解释性分析。

Result: 二元检测F1为0.985、AUC为0.997；九类分类宏平均F1为0.700、AUC为0.963，优于单模态基线。可解释性分析显示飞行时间与惯性模态贡献最大，层次聚类表明误分类主要由手势解剖区域驱动。

Conclusion: 多模态传感器融合可实现准确、客观、连续的行为监测，为实时可穿戴辅助心理健康诊断和个性化干预在生物医学研究与临床护理中的应用奠定了基础。

Abstract: Body-focused repetitive behaviors, such as hair pulling and skin picking, are compulsive motor actions commonly associated with obsessive-compulsive and anxiety disorders. Their early, objective detection remains difficult because the movements are subtle and overlap with ordinary, non-pathological gestures. We developed and evaluated a multimodal deep learning framework to detect and classify these behaviors from wrist-worn sensor data. The data, collected by the Child Mind Institute using the Helios wrist-worn device, combine inertial measurement units, thermopile sensors, and time-of-flight sensors, capturing kinematic, thermal, and proximity information. The framework combined a convolutional neural network with a gated recurrent unit, alongside modality-specific autoencoders and a late-fusion classifier, to exploit temporal and spatial dynamics. It achieved an F1 score of 0.985 and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.997 for binary detection, distinguishing these behaviors from other activities, and a macro-averaged F1 score of 0.700 with an area under the curve of 0.963 across a nine-class scheme that distinguished each individual behavior from a single grouped Non-Target class, improving over single-modality baselines. Post-hoc interpretability based on Shapley additive explanations showed that the time-of-flight and inertial modalities dominated discriminative power by capturing spatial proximity and dynamic movement, while hierarchical clustering indicated that misclassifications were driven primarily by the anatomical region of the gesture. These findings demonstrate that multimodal sensor fusion enables accurate, objective, and continuous behavioral monitoring. This work establishes a foundation for real-time, wearable-assisted mental health diagnostics and personalized interventions in biomedical research and clinical care.

</details>


### [396] [Real-Time Climate Risk Assessment for Supply Chain Resilience: A Data-Driven Nowcasting Framework for Colombian Agriculture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09846)
*Hernan J. Silva-Sosa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于数据驱动临近预报（nowcasting）的实时气候风险评估方法框架，用于增强哥伦比亚农业供应链的韧性。该框架将短期气候预测与供应链风险建模相结合，构建了早期预警系统架构，原型实验证明短期降水预测可转化为可操作的农业供应链风险指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 哥伦比亚气候变异性大，降雨不规则、温度波动频繁且极端事件多发，直接影响尤其是对时间敏感农作物的农业生产和物流。现有研究缺乏将气候临近预报与供应链决策有效整合的方法框架，亟需一种能够将短期气候预测转化为可操作风险信号的系统性方法。

Method: 该方法整合了基于历史气象观测的短期气候预报（临近预报）与供应链风险建模，构建了概念性早期预警系统架构。通过明确的风险映射、基于阈值的分类以及面向利益相关者的风险信号来实现气候临近预报与供应链决策的集成。原型系统在受控计算环境中开发，使用官方统计和再分析产品中的历史气象与农业时间序列数据，不依赖卫星影像或计算机视觉组件。

Result: 在合成数据和历史数据实验中，短期降水临近预报能够成功转化为可操作的农业供应链风险指标，可支持与库存、采购和运输相关的预见性决策，验证了该框架的可行性。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了气候临近预报与供应链风险建模集成的可行性与有效性，为哥伦比亚农业供应链的气候韧性建设提供了一种不依赖卫星影像的轻量化早期预警方法框架，能够支持前瞻性的供应链决策。

Abstract: This paper presents a methodological framework for real-time climate risk assessment using data-driven nowcasting techniques to enhance supply chain resilience in Colombian agricultural contexts. Climate variability in Colombia, characterized by irregular rainfall, temperature fluctuations, and recurrent extreme events, has a direct impact on agricultural production and logistics, particularly for time sensitive crops. The proposed approach integrates short term climate forecasting based on historical meteorological observations with supply chain risk modeling to establish a conceptual early warning system architecture. A prototype implementation developed in a controlled computational environment demonstrates the feasibility of the framework using historical meteorological and agricultural time series derived from official statistics and reanalysis products, without reliance on satellite imagery or computer vision components. The methodology addresses the integration of climate nowcasting with supply chain decision making through explicit risk mapping, threshold-based categorization, and stakeholder-oriented risk signals. Results from synthetic and historical data experiments indicate that short term precipitation nowcasts can be translated into actionable risk indicators for agricultural supply chains, supporting anticipatory decisions related to inventory, sourcing, and transport.

</details>


### [397] [Fairness in Link Prediction Beyond Demographic Parity: A Reproducibility Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09899)
*Valentijn Oldenburg,Floris de Kam,Stef de Wildt,Jarno Nilson Balk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文复现了Mattos等人(2025)的研究，验证了公平排名链接预测中Δ_DP指标无法检测曝光偏差的论点，并进一步验证了MORAL后处理方法在提升曝光公平性的同时保持效用。研究在更广泛的合成同质性设置、分类敏感属性和额外公平性/效用指标（包括AWRF）下进行了鲁棒性评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公平排名指标Δ_DP只关注聚合层面的统计均衡，忽略了链接在排名中的位置，可能掩盖系统性排名偏差。作者希望验证这一局限，并检验MORAL方法的有效性是否在不同设置下仍然成立。

Method: 通过复现实验证明Δ_DP在子群对链接被系统性地排在较低位置时仍可能显示聚合均衡；采用排名感知的NDKL指标检测此类偏差；在合成同质性设置、分类敏感属性下，使用AWRF和多种公平性/效用指标对MORAL进行鲁棒性评估。

Result: 复现确认了Δ_DP无法检测排名中的曝光偏差，而NDKL能够识别此类差异；MORAL方法在提升曝光公平性的同时保持了竞争性的效用水平，且在多样化设置和数据集上均表现出最小效用损失。

Conclusion: 曝光感知指标能揭示Δ_DP所隐藏的偏差，MORAL在多种场景下均可有效降低曝光偏差且效用损失极小。作者发布了可复现的修正版实现代码。

Abstract: In fair ranked link prediction, demographic parity ($Δ_\mathrm{DP}$) is a common fairness metric. Yet, Mattos et al. (2025) argue that it fails to detect exposure bias because it ignores where links appear in the ranking. In this study, we reproduce this claim by showing that $Δ_\mathrm{DP}$ can indicate aggregate parity even when some subgroup-pair links are systematically ranked lower than others. The proposed rank-aware Normalized Discounted KL-divergence (NDKL), however, does detect such disparities. We also reproduce the effectiveness of MORAL, a post-processing method that improves exposure-based fairness while maintaining competitive utility. Beyond reproduction, we assess robustness using synthetic homophily settings, categorical sensitive attributes, and additional fairness and utility metrics, including subgroup-pair-adapted Attention-Weighted Rank Fairness (AWRF). Overall, our results show that exposure-based metrics uncover biases hidden by $Δ_\mathrm{DP}$ and that MORAL reduces these biases with minimal utility loss across diverse settings and datasets. We release a corrected, reproducible implementation at https://github.com/Floris93100/reproducing-MORAL.

</details>


<div id='cs.HC'></div>

# cs.HC [[Back]](#toc)

### [398] [Designing for Ethical AI: HCI Feature Considerations to Improve Fairness and User Experience in AutoML use for Human Resources](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07477)
*Sundaraparipurnan Narayanan*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 本论文通过法规、商业战略和人机交互（HCI）三个视角，审视AutoML工具在人力资源招聘系统中的公平性问题，提出公平性已从道德关切转变为可用性、信任、合规与采纳的关键决定因素。研究通过质性HCI审计和量化测试对八个AutoML平台进行评估，发现透明度、用户控制和偏见缓解支持方面普遍存在缺陷，并提出了基于HCI的五维公平性评估框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AutoML平台虽提高了建模效率，但基于有偏历史招聘数据训练时可能延续歧视性结果。现有平台优先考虑技术性能而忽视公平性，使非专家业务用户无法有效检测或缓解偏见，公平性已成为影响组织采纳和合规的关键因素。

Method: 研究围绕四个研究问题展开，涵盖公平机制、界面透明度、人工监督和产品设计优先级。采用技术接受模型、创新扩散理论、人本AI、认知负荷理论和可供性理论等框架，结合质性HCI审计与对八个AutoML平台在HR数据集上的量化测试。

Result: 研究发现AutoML平台在透明度、用户控制和偏见缓解支持方面普遍存在广泛缺陷，公平性与可用性之间存在显著脱节，非专家用户难以识别和纠正算法偏见。

Conclusion: 论文提出五维HCI公平性评估框架，建议将公平性直接嵌入AutoML产品设计，以提升AI招聘系统的问责性、采纳率和伦理可持续性。

Abstract: This thesis examines the fairness of Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) tools in human resource hiring systems through the combined lenses of regulation, business strategy, and Human-Computer Interaction (HCI). It argues that fairness is no longer merely an ethical concern but a critical determinant of usability, trust, legal compliance, and organizational adoption. While AutoML platforms improve efficiency by simplifying model selection and deployment, they also risk perpetuating discriminatory outcomes when trained on biased historical hiring data. Existing platforms prioritize technical performance over fairness, leaving non-expert business users unable to detect or mitigate bias effectively. The study investigates fairness gaps in AutoML tools through four research questions focused on fairness mechanisms, interface transparency, human oversight, and product design priorities. Drawing on frameworks such as the Technology Acceptance Model, Innovation Diffusion Theory, Human-Centered AI, Cognitive Load Theory, and Affordance Theory, the research evaluates both usability and fairness alignment. Using qualitative HCI audits and quantitative testing of eight AutoML platforms on HR datasets, the findings reveal widespread deficiencies in transparency, user control, and bias mitigation support. The thesis proposes a five-dimensional HCI-based fairness evaluation framework and recommends embedding fairness directly into AutoML product design to improve accountability, adoption, and ethical sustainability in AI-driven hiring systems.

</details>


### [399] [Cross-Model Humor Preference Modeling with Cards Against Humanity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07481)
*Victor Winter,Farhan Lakhany*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型能否在Cards Against Humanity风格任务中模拟另一个模型的幽默偏好。通过反射单元格稳定性程序隔离出244个手牌，将GPT-4o作为Czar、Claude Opus-4.5作为Player，在五个渐变条件下评估其二元幽默选择任务。结果显示，仅通过角色指令和模型身份只能获得小幅提升（0.7%→19.0%/25.9%），而直接的行为证据和理由能带来显著提升（72.8%/82.3%）。这表明行为证据而非框架效应对跨模型偏好建模至关重要，可被解释为操作性而非表征性的类心智理论行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究大型语言模型是否能够近似理解并模拟另一个模型（而非自身）的幽默偏好，特别是在无法通过自我偏好来获得成功的情境下，从而验证跨模型的心智理论（Theory of Mind）能力。

Method: 使用反射单元格稳定性程序构建244个两模型存在确定性但相反偏好的手牌，分为97个上下文池和147个测试池。设计五种渐增条件：默认自我偏好、通用Czar建模指令、模型识别的Czar、先前Czar选择、带理由的先前Czar选择。使用Cochran's Q检验和配对McNemar检验验证各条件间的统计显著性差异。

Result: Player准确率从条件1的0.7%分别提升至仅框架效应条件的19.0%和25.9%，在提供行为证据后跃升至72.8%，再加上理由后达到82.3%。Cochran's Q检验和配对McNemar检验均确认渐变中每一步都产生显著提升。

Conclusion: 角色指令和模型身份带来的收益有限，而行为证据尤其是附带理由的行为证据能大幅支持跨模型偏好建模。该行为可被解读为操作性意义上的类心智理论能力——模型从自我偏好转向另一智能体展示的偏好，但不应宣称其具备对心理状态的底层表征。

Abstract: This paper investigates whether one large language model can approximate the humor preferences of another in a controlled Cards Against Humanity-style task. Two models - GPT-4o as Czar and Claude Opus-4.5 as Player - are evaluated on a binary humor-selection task constructed so that success cannot follow from self-preference. A reflected-cell stability procedure isolates 244 hands on which the two models hold deterministic but opposite preferences, partitioned into a 97-hand context pool and a 147-hand held-out test pool. The Player is then evaluated across five graded conditions: default self-preference, generic Czar-modeling instruction, model-identified Czar, prior Czar selections, and prior Czar selections with rationales. This gradient is designed to separate two sources of improvement: framing effects, in which the Player is told to attend to a Czar without seeing any of the Czar's behavior, and direct behavioral evidence, in which the Player is shown the Czar's prior choices. Player accuracy increased from 0.7% in Condition 1 to 19.0% and 25.9% in the framing-only conditions, and then rose to 72.8% and 82.3% once behavioral evidence and rationales were provided. An omnibus Cochran's Q test and pairwise McNemar tests confirmed that each step in the gradient produced a significant improvement. The results indicate that role instruction and model identity yield only modest gains, while behavioral evidence - especially when accompanied by rationales - supports substantial cross-model preference modeling. The findings are interpreted as theory-of-mind-like behavior in an operational rather than representational sense: the Player shifts away from self-preference toward another agent's demonstrated preferences, without any claim about an underlying representation of mental states.

</details>


### [400] [From Human-Centered Design to Human-AI Collaboration: Why the Future of HCI Still Starts With People](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07482)
*Issam Alzouby*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，主张生成式AI不应取代以人为本的设计（HCD），而应作为人类目标的共同思考伙伴，强调随着AI能力增强，传统HCD原则变得更加重要，未来HCI应聚焦于保留人类能动性、批判性思维和责任感的协作方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI虽然加速了HCI工作流程（如头脑风暴、写作、原型设计和界面生成），但更快的产出并不自动带来以人为本的设计。作者通过对HCI课程、设计活动和AI辅助工作流的反思，指出需要重新审视GenAI在HCI中的角色定位。

Method: 基于作者对HCI课程教学、设计实践以及AI辅助工作流的经验反思，采用立场论述（position paper）的方式，分析GenAI带来的新风险（过度依赖、技能退化、浅层推理、幻觉、作者身份不清、问责性降低），并论证传统HCD原则在AI能力增强时的持续重要性。

Result: 论文提出GenAI应被视为与人类目标、伦理、认知和问责性相驱动的共同思考伙伴，而非人本方法的替代品。未来的HCI发展方向应聚焦于人机协作，保留人类能动性、批判性思维和责任感。

Conclusion: 随着AI系统能力日益增强，传统以人为本的设计原则不仅不会过时，反而变得更加关键。HCI领域未来的核心挑战是在提升AI协作效率的同时，确保人类在交互中的主动性和责任不被削弱。

Abstract: Generative AI is reshaping HCI work by accelerating brainstorming, writing, prototyping, and interface generation. However, faster production does not automatically produce human-centered design. This position paper argues that GenAI should be treated not as a replacement for human-centered methods, but as a co-thinking partner driven by human goals, ethics, cognition, and accountability. After reflecting on HCI coursework, design activities, and AI-assisted workflows, I argue that traditional HCD principles become more important as AI systems become more capable. Users still bring limited attention, mental models, trust issues, and cognitive biases into interaction, while GenAI introduces new risks around over-reliance, de-skilling, shallow reasoning, hallucination, unclear authorship, and reduced accountability. The future of HCI should therefore focus on human-AI collaboration that preserves human agency, critical thinking, and responsibility.

</details>


### [401] [Generative AI as Support, Not Replacement, in Human-Centered Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07483)
*Amir Talakoob*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 本文探讨AI如何重塑以人为中心的设计，认为部分变化将超越短期热潮，同时提出过度依赖AI、减少人类判断、偏见、数据安全和问责不清等风险，并建议提升AI素养、审慎伦理判断和明确使用边界以保持设计的"以人为本"核心。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着ChatGPT等AI工具在2022年底的公开普及，AI在设计研究与实践中的快速应用引发关注，作者希望审视这些变化是否具有持久性，并识别其带来的风险与局限。

Method: 采用立场论文（position paper）的方式，基于对AI在设计中的应用现状进行批判性分析，论证AI带来的变革将超越短期热潮，并系统梳理相关风险与应对策略。

Result: 论文指出AI正在改变设计者理解用户、生成创意、评估系统和做设计决策的方式，其中部分变化具有长期持久性；同时识别了主要风险和局限，并认为AI素养和伦理判断是必要应对措施。

Conclusion: 为保持设计的"以人为本"导向，需要建立AI素养、审慎的伦理判断和更清晰的AI使用边界，以平衡AI带来的效率提升与人类中心价值的保留。

Abstract: Traditional human-centered design is grounded in human needs, behaviors, and experiences, especially throughout the development of products and services. Recent advances in artificial intelligence and machine learning, accelerated by the public launch of ChatGPT in November 2022, have created a wave of AI adoption across research, industry, and design practice. While some of this rapid adoption reflects the current enthusiasm and overuse surrounding AI tools, it has also introduced lasting changes to how designers and researchers understand users, generate ideas, evaluate systems, and make design decisions. This position paper examines how AI is reshaping human-centered design and argues that some of these changes are likely to extend beyond short-term hype. It also considers the risks and limitations introduced by this shift, including over-reliance on AI, reduced human judgment, bias, data security concerns, and unclear accountability. Finally, the paper suggests that AI literacy, careful ethical judgment, and clearer boundaries for AI use are necessary for preserving the human-centered focus of design.

</details>


### [402] [Using the gameplay and user data to predict and identify causes of cybersickness manifestation in virtual reality games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07484)
*Thiago Porcino,Erick Oliveira Rodrigues,Alexandre Silva,Esteban Clua,Daniela Trevisan*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种通过随机森林分类器预测VR用户晕动症（CS）症状的新方法，并构建了专门的CS配置文件问卷数据集（86名受试者），用于提前判断用户是否进入不适状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VR技术虽广泛应用，但晕动症（CS）问题严重影响了沉浸式体验，现有方案无法提前预测用户的CS症状，因此需要一种能够预判用户是否将进入不适状态的方法。

Method: 提出CS配置文件问卷来收集用户历史条件和沉浸环境反应数据，基于86名受试者在不同日期的问卷回答构建数据集，采用随机森林分类器，并通过16种机器学习技术进行交叉验证以确认最佳性能。

Result: 随机森林分类器在16种机器学习技术中表现最佳，能够有效预测用户即将出现的CS症状，并可识别导致不适情境的关键属性（原因及个体参数）。

Conclusion: 该方案能够在用户进入VR不适状态前提供预警，并为识别CS诱因提供数据支持，有助于改善VR体验的舒适度。

Abstract: Virtual reality (VR) is an imminent trend in games, education, entertainment, military, and health applications, as the use of head-mounted displays is accessible to everyone. While VR provides immersive experiences, it still does not offer an entirely perfect situation, mainly due to cybersickness (CS) issues. In this work, we propose a novel approach for predicting upcoming CS symptoms. Our solution is able to suggest whether the user of VR is entering into an illness situation. We adopted random forest classifiers and validated our solution using 16 different machine-learning techniques, which presented the best results. For training purposes, we built our own dataset through a CS profile questionnaire that we also propose in the present work. The questionnaire is focused on registering and identifying the user's susceptibility to CS, considering their historical conditions and also their response to the immersive environment developed by us. In this method, 86 individuals are selected and the developed questionnaire was put to them on different days, and the answers are compiled as dataset. Our proposal also identifying attributes responsible (causes and individual's parameters) for the observed stressful and uncomfortable situations.

</details>


### [403] [Humour as Resistance: Visceralizing the Environmental and Social Impact of AI through Humour-based Creative Practices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07485)
*Han Qiao,Rowan O. A. Munson,Nadia Mariyan Smith,Eshta Bhardwaj,Christoph Becker*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于通过幽默创意活动揭示AI基础设施对环境和社会的隐性成本的研究。作者作为设计师和研究者，通过图形设计、实体装置、数字内容和共创工作坊等形式，利用幽默作为创意实践来引发集体反思。通过活动民族志、调查和访谈，他们识别出幽默创意工作在HCI中的四种角色：连接关键朋友的情感纽带、 visceral情感港、社会粘合剂和权力抵抗工具。论文主张创意实践在弥合人们与技术关切之间的社会和情感鸿沟方面具有重要价值，能揭示隐藏视角以促进更具包容性的对话。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI增长的环境和社会成本常被主流叙事掩盖，即便被承认也常伴随无力感。作者希望通过幽默创意活动来对抗这种叙事的缺失和无助情绪，促进人们对AI基础设施物质影响的集体反思。

Method: 采用行动研究方法，作者团队设计并实施了基于幽默的创意活动，包括图形设计、物理装置、数字内容创作和共创工作坊。数据收集采用活动民族志、问卷调查和对活动参与者的访谈，随后归纳提炼出幽默创意工作的角色框架。

Result: 研究识别出幽默创意工作在HCI中的四个关键角色：（1）连接关键朋友的桥梁；（2）提供visceral和情感层面的港湾；（3）作为社交粘合剂；（4）作为抵抗权力的工具。研究发现幽默有效促进了人们与技术议题之间的社会与情感连接。

Conclusion: 作者强调创意实践（尤其是幽默形式）在弥合人与技术议题之间的社会和情感鸿沟方面具有重要价值，能够揭示通常被忽视的隐藏视角，为更包容的技术对话铺平道路。

Abstract: The growth of AI does not come without cost. While we hear about the economic costs, the environmental and social costs are often obfuscated by mainstream narratives, and even when acknowledged, are accompanied by a sense of helplessness. To counter this, we, a group of designers and researchers, reflect on our experience leading a humour-based creative campaign surfacing the material impact of AI infrastructures. Through graphics design, physical installations, digital content creation and co-creation workshops, we leaned into humour as a creative practice to provoke collective reflection. Drawing on event ethnography, surveys and interviews with campaign engagers, we examine four roles of humour-based creative work in HCI: a connector to critical friends, a visceral and emotional harbour, social glue, and resistance to power. We argue for the importance of creative practices in bridging social and emotional gaps between people and concerns around technology, and in surfacing hidden perspectives for more inclusive conversations.

</details>


### [404] [A Symbolic Machine Learning Approach for Cybersickness Potential-Cause Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07486)
*Thiago Porcino,Érick Oliveira Rodrigues,Flavia Bernardini,Daniela Trevisan,Esteban Clua*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于符号机器学习的实验分析方法，用于对虚拟现实（VR）中的晕动症（cybersickness, CS）潜在诱因进行排序。实验在两个不同的VR游戏中进行，发现加速在赛车游戏中比飞行游戏更频繁地诱发晕动症，且VR经验较少的参与者更容易感到不适，该变量在赛车游戏中的影响大于飞行游戏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VR和头戴式显示器在多个领域日益普及，虽然提供了高沉浸感，但可能引发晕动症（CS）这一不适症状。现有研究缺乏对晕动症诱因进行系统化排序和影响的量化分析，因此需要一种新的方法来确定哪些因素对晕动症的分类能力影响最大。

Method: 采用符号机器学习方法进行实验分析，通过构建分类模型来估计晕动症的潜在诱因，并依据其对晕动症分类能力的影响程度对这些诱因进行排序。实验在两个不同类型的虚拟现实游戏（赛车游戏和飞行游戏）中开展，对比不同场景下各诱因的影响差异。

Result: 实验结果表明：加速在赛车游戏中比飞行游戏更频繁地诱发晕动症；VR经验较少的参与者更容易感到不适，且该变量在赛车游戏中的影响更大，而在飞行游戏中由于加速不由用户控制，影响相对较小。

Conclusion: 符号机器学习能够有效识别和排序晕动症的潜在诱因，且不同游戏类型（用户是否控制加速）会影响诱因的作用程度。该研究为VR领域晕动症的预防和用户体验优化提供了数据驱动的分析依据。

Abstract: Virtual reality (VR) and head-mounted displays are constantly gaining popularity in various fields such as education, military, entertainment, and bio/medical informatics. Although such technologies provide a high sense of immersion, they can also trigger symptoms of discomfort. This condition is called cybersickness (CS) and is quite popular in recent publications in the virtual reality context. This work proposes a novel experimental analysis using symbolic machine learning that ranks potential causes for CS. We estimate the CS causes and rank them according to their impact on the classification capabilities of CS. The experiments are performed using two distinct virtual reality games. We were able to identify that acceleration triggered cybersickness more frequently in a race game in contrast to a flight game. Furthermore, participants less experienced with VR are more prone to feel discomfort and this variable has a greater impact in the race game in contrast to the flight game, where the acceleration is not controlled by the user.

</details>


### [405] [SafeStudent Driving: A Multimodal Driver-Safety System to Support Teen Drivers Using Computer Vision and Mobile Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07487)
*Max Liu,Yu Sun*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 本文介绍SafeStudent Driving系统，一个针对青少年新手驾驶员的多模态驾驶辅助系统，部署在Raspberry Pi和Flutter移动应用上，通过YOLO视觉模型、OCR、音频模型和IMU数据实时检测交通信号和转向灯使用，并通过语音提示帮助新手司机养成安全驾驶习惯。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 青少年驾驶员事故率显著偏高，主要原因是经验不足且对基本交通规则的注意力不稳定，需要低成本、实用的辅助系统来帮助新手驾驶员安全驾驶。

Method: 系统采用三个基于YOLO的计算机视觉模型分别检测交通灯、灯泡颜色和道路标志，使用OCR模块读取限速值，结合音频模型和IMU数据推断转弯时的转向灯使用情况。分析层对检测结果进行时间平滑处理，并通过文本转语音或预录音频触发优先级语音提示。

Result: 实验重点关注标志检测和转向灯识别，展示了系统的优势场景和失败模式，验证了在有限硬件上实现实时推理的可行性，以及系统在多变光照条件下取得合理模型精度的能力。

Conclusion: 该项目展示了一种实用、低成本的帮助新手驾驶员在真实交通中建立安全驾驶习惯的方案，为后续改进和扩展提供了方向。

Abstract: Teen drivers face disproportionately high crash rates, often due to inexperience and inconsistent attention to basic traffic rules. SafeStudent Driving addresses this problem with a multimodal coaching system deployed on both a Raspberry Pi device and a Flutter-based mobile app. The system uses three YOLO-based computer-vision models to detect traffic lights, light-bulb colors, and road signs, an OCR module to read speed-limit values, and an audio model plus IMU data to infer whether turn signals are used during turns. An analysis layer smooths detections over time and triggers prioritized voice prompts through text-to-speech or pre-recorded audio.
  Key challenges included achieving sufficient model accuracy in varied lighting, running inference fast enough on limited hardware, and designing prompts that inform without distracting the driver [3]. Experiments on sign detection and turn-signal recognition highlight strengths and failure modes, guiding future improvements.
